GRADE 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 80 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Self-awareness at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. mention his or her name for identification and self- awareness,
   B. Learners should ignore Self-awareness completely.
   C. Self-awareness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self-awareness.

2. About Self-awareness at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God,
   B. Learners should ignore Self-awareness completely.
   C. Self-awareness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self-awareness.

3. About Self-awareness when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. acknowledge God as the creator,
   B. Learners should ignore Self-awareness completely.
   C. Self-awareness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self-awareness.

5. About Thoughts and feelings at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify good thoughts and feelings,
   B. Learners should ignore Thoughts and feelings completely.
   C. Thoughts and feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Thoughts and feelings.

6. About Thoughts and feelings at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of being joyful,
   B. Learners should ignore Thoughts and feelings completely.
   C. Thoughts and feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Thoughts and feelings.

7. About Thoughts and feelings when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify good thoughts and feelings,
   B. Learners should ignore Thoughts and feelings completely.
   C. Thoughts and feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Thoughts and feelings.

9. About Making choices at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. list choices they make in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Making choices completely.
   C. Making choices is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Making choices.

10. About Making choices at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss results of choices they make in daily life,
   B. Learners should ignore Making choices completely.
   C. Making choices is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Making choices.

11. About Making choices when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. make right choices guided by the word of God,
   B. Learners should ignore Making choices completely.
   C. Making choices is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Making choices.

13. About My Family Family members at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. name family members in the nuclear and extended family,
   B. Learners should ignore My Family Family members completely.
   C. My Family Family members is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My Family Family members.

14. About My Family Family members at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family,
   B. Learners should ignore My Family Family members completely.
   C. My Family Family members is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My Family Family members.

15. About My Family Family members when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. explain why it is important to honour parents,
   B. Learners should ignore My Family Family members completely.
   C. My Family Family members is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My Family Family members.

17. About Attributes of God at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. read scriptures on the attributes of God,
   B. Learners should ignore Attributes of God completely.
   C. Attributes of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Attributes of God.

18. About Attributes of God at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. list three attributes of God and revere Him,
   B. Learners should ignore Attributes of God completely.
   C. Attributes of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Attributes of God.

19. About Attributes of God when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. read scriptures on the attributes of God,
   B. Learners should ignore Attributes of God completely.
   C. Attributes of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Attributes of God.

21. About The Inspired Word of God at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. handle the Holy Bible with respect as the inspired word of God,
   B. Learners should ignore The Inspired Word of God completely.
   C. The Inspired Word of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Inspired Word of God.

22. About The Inspired Word of God at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the books in the Old and New Testament,
   B. Learners should ignore The Inspired Word of God completely.
   C. The Inspired Word of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Inspired Word of God.

23. About The Inspired Word of God when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. role play naming some books in the Bible,
   B. Learners should ignore The Inspired Word of God completely.
   C. The Inspired Word of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Inspired Word of God.

25. About Zacchaeus the Tax Collector at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the story of Zacchaeus,
   B. Learners should ignore Zacchaeus the Tax Collector completely.
   C. Zacchaeus the Tax Collector is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.

26. About Zacchaeus the Tax Collector at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. recount how Zacchaeus changed his behaviour positively,
   B. Learners should ignore Zacchaeus the Tax Collector completely.
   C. Zacchaeus the Tax Collector is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.

27. About Zacchaeus the Tax Collector when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate integrity when using money,
   B. Learners should ignore Zacchaeus the Tax Collector completely.
   C. Zacchaeus the Tax Collector is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.

29. About Balaam’s Donkey at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the story of Balaam and his donkey,
   B. Learners should ignore Balaam’s Donkey completely.
   C. Balaam’s Donkey is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Balaam’s Donkey.

30. About Balaam’s Donkey at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. apply the story in their lives by obeying God’s instructions,
   B. Learners should ignore Balaam’s Donkey completely.
   C. Balaam’s Donkey is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Balaam’s Donkey.

31. About Balaam’s Donkey when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. acquire the value of love by speaking good things about others,
   B. Learners should ignore Balaam’s Donkey completely.
   C. Balaam’s Donkey is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Balaam’s Donkey.

33. About Samson kills a Lion at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9,
   B. Learners should ignore Samson kills a Lion completely.
   C. Samson kills a Lion is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Samson kills a Lion.

34. About Samson kills a Lion at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. acknowledge God’s power in his or her life,
   B. Learners should ignore Samson kills a Lion completely.
   C. Samson kills a Lion is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Samson kills a Lion.

35. About Samson kills a Lion when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9,
   B. Learners should ignore Samson kills a Lion completely.
   C. Samson kills a Lion is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Samson kills a Lion.

37. About Joseph interprets a Dream at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream,
   B. Learners should ignore Joseph interprets a Dream completely.
   C. Joseph interprets a Dream is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Joseph interprets a Dream.

38. About Joseph interprets a Dream at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. apply lessons learnt by depending on God’s wisdom,
   B. Learners should ignore Joseph interprets a Dream completely.
   C. Joseph interprets a Dream is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Joseph interprets a Dream.

39. About Joseph interprets a Dream when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream,
   B. Learners should ignore Joseph interprets a Dream completely.
   C. Joseph interprets a Dream is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Joseph interprets a Dream.
